notes.accolades_stored: workbook history (seasons before this one), as migrated
notes.accolades_exported: what the end-of-season roster carried: stored history plus this season's cup, RT and Division One titles (no World Championship titles -- the export never awarded them)
notes.final_d_sqrt_raw: raw 0-10 DSCR (the carryover seed), not the 0-100 OVR component
notes.dscr_*_cap400: average with each game capped at 400, for the tiebreak only
notes.regional_standings / division_standings: final order 1-16 by the season's own standings rule (W-L, head-to-head, then uncapped DSCR)
